analogy.rationale: The class 'anticancer agent' is a broad umbrella whose members act through diverse cytotoxic and cytostatic mechanisms, so the most similar reference class is the equally broad 'antineoplastic agent', with kinase inhibitors and angiogenesis inhibitors sharing downstream growth-arrest/apoptosis programs. The annotated targets TNF and CYP2E1 are not the primary mediators of the transcriptional response in these cell lines, so similarity to any single targeted class is limited.
